purpose: Declares which canon concepts are blocked on a fact outside this repository. 'Blocked' is the most abusable label available -- anything unbuilt can be described as waiting on something -- so a gate must come from the reviewed vocabulary in src/sovereign-coverage-matrix.mjs, must name a concept a source artifact actually states, and must carry stated evidence. Any failure fails the whole matrix compile.
truthBoundary: EXTERNAL_BLOCKED MEANS NO ENGINEERING IN THIS REPOSITORY CLOSES THE GAP. IT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE WORK WOULD OTHERWISE BE DONE.
